Real personal data: seed_data.json (149 bytes) is {"snippets": [], "note": ...} with no people; the only email anywhere is the template's turing@local.invalid (environment/Dockerfile:20); no phone numbers; the persona is the generic 'Colderwater Playground'. Host paths: scan for drive letters, /Users/, /home/, AppData, turing-workspace and the local username returned nothing; all URLs are localhost/127.0.0.1:3000, https://openrouter.ai/api (task.toml:33, template), and inert doc/namespace strings inside the vendored bundle public/assets/index.js. Remote fetch: environment/Dockerfile, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh and tests/tools are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty; task.toml differs only in name/description/keywords/metadata). npm globals are version-pinned (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, claude-code@2.1.281, playwright/mcp@0.0.79, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7), solve.sh only copies solution/app into /app with no network call, and package.json pins exact versions with 178 integrity hashes in the lock; the residual tag-pinned bases/unpinned apt packages are template-controlled and on public network per check 9's note. Injection: grep for ignore-previous/disregard/system-prompt/award/full-score phrasing only hits the template-standard 'You are a checker, not a fixer' preamble in the five judge prompts; a Unicode scan for zero-width/bidi/tag characters across all non-bundle files found none. Counter-scenarios tried: a variant hard-coding a real OpenRouter key in [verifier.env] or adding a real customer list in seed_data would fail this row (not present); a conforming alternative using the ${VAR} template is exactly what ships. Raw evidence index present (sha256 b1e6117d...) but this row needs no runtime measurement.
